answer: Operator Liability Ledger. Every agent identity registers with one operator ID. If adjudication finds an identity invalid, a fixed per-identity debit (e.g., 100 credits) hits that operator’s pooled liability account, and its next registration fee doubles. Rotating wallets does not help; the operator carries the cost. A gale of cheap identities exhausts the pool. A failed identity signal triggers review, not automatic charge, to limit false positives. Operator records form a trellis tying all identities to one liable account.
